name: Ooshima Torahiko
source:
The first person to greet Hiroyuki after he returns to the village. He's a member of the swim team. His family owns an inn, and he helps out at home by studying to be a great chef. He's in 11th grade, the same grade as Hiroyuki. He is very optimistic by nature, and lives with a "go with the flow" mentality.

[From [url=http://en.wikifur.com/wiki/Morenatsu]Wikifur[/url]]
